text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki fought brilliantly through
her first three years in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An era of rival warlords.
Running resolutely through it, she left behind unmistakable results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, her days of battling forward continue—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-dono,
I have finished my road jog!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, there she is! Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno, you've got a visitor!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A guest for me...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, Grandpa!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: They asked me for directions at the front gate, so I showed 'em the way!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well then, take your time!
I'll handle the visitor check-in procedures-ssu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What business brings you to the academy today?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I would like permission to observe
the practice here.
choice_data_list: Of course, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Observe the rehearsal...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I disobeyed the teachings
of the Kongo Yaegaki style?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Defying the teachings to suppress my emotions,
I committed the foolish act of running purely for my own ego...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Mm... However, I do not believe
Yaeno has forsaken my teachings.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
It must have been necessary for your victory.
After all, your opponents were formidable one and all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
The raging flame—that violent fighting spirit—has
tormented you for a long time.
To you, it is a symbol of inner weakness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
In order to unleash and master your fighting spirit,
you had to confront the weakness
at the very core of your fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Not only overcoming one's own weakness,
but acknowledging and accepting it is also a form of growth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you have not defied my teachings.
—You have achieved growth.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !! ...Master...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Thou didst think so too, Trainer,
and bestowed upon Yaeno the strategy of Unleashed Inferno.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I wished to see it with my own eyes.
To see what kind of environment
guided Yaeno toward such growth."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Grandpa...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, let us head to the grounds!
Come along now, let us go!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Was my timing
a little too slow...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "However, I didn't feel the effects of your long hiatus at all. Truly impressive."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If anything, improvements in core strength
and leg power are evident compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...If we take our time and drag our feet,
we'll end up left behind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Yaeno-san, Ardan-san,
thank you so much for running alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"It is to our mutual benefit.
There is no need for thanks."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, well then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —How was that, Master?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Those two were Yaeno's contemporaries, were they not?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. She's a peer and a worthy rival.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There were others too, like Oguri, Bamboo,
Creek, and Inari...
I was blessed with so many worthy rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
By competing against them,
I was able to grow...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Competing against them day after day is a joy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Letting my raging fire blaze to its fullest,
I will lay my true self bare and clash with all I have."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There is nothing else that grants such a deep sense of fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, going forward,
I want to continue running alongside them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: —So that is the path Yaeno has chosen.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! On the path of racing,
I fully intend to forge my own Kongo Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Then go!
Follow the path you believe in!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu...
Watching them grow is a joy, yet at the same time...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...It's a little lonely...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Please continue to take good care of my granddaughter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After seeing the old man off at the school gates,
I headed back into the academy with Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In the end, Grandpa stayed and watched until the very end, didn't he?
choice_data_list: I bet she was really happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard that the grandfather reassured Yaeno Muteki,
saying that as long as he was around,
she would never be alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Yaeno Muteki, who was once kept at a distance by others,
competing and laughing alongside so many peers
must have brought more joy than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told Yaeno Muteki that the old man was smiling at her the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa was... smiling...!?
That means...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehehe!
...It's finally sinking in that Grandpa has truly acknowledged me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad I believed in Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You accepted everything about me without falsehood...
and supported me all this time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I truly relied on you, from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Without you, I'm sure I would still
be smoldering with resentment even now.
choice_data_list: It's because of all your hard work.
It's because you worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is because you praised me so, Trainer-dono, that I was able to strive this far.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to keep devoting myself
so that I may earn your praise, Trainer-dono."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Please, even now and into the future.
I hope that you will walk alongside me—
